can_say: The benchmark uses exact-linked cells nested within fields and screens and evaluates field, gene and whole-screen holdouts.
cannot_say: The schematic does not establish comparative model performance.

can_say: With arithmetic-mean reporter scores the prespecified MLP exceeds scButterfly and MIDAS for both field/gene metrics and Ridge for field KO/cell and gene cell recovery: 11 of 54 comparisons meet Holm54 and absolute median effect >=0.02.
cannot_say: Gene KO MLP versus Ridge has median paired gain 0.017603 and fails the effect gate; reporter points are not independent cells; marginal median ordering does not establish paired superiority; failing the criteria is not equivalence.

can_say: Observed performance and method spread can be displayed across physical screens on the same frozen score scale; the summaries are descriptive.
cannot_say: Screen spread cannot be interpreted as a pure environment effect or a variance decomposition because most screens contain a single reporter; method spread is not sampling uncertainty.

can_say: Reporter-by-screen assays describe the observed target-context combinations; whole-screen cell scores are evaluated directly in destination cells.
cannot_say: The assay view does not create measurements for unobserved combinations; field/gene cell-level assay views repeat 52 reporter-level values across 99 marks and cannot resolve within-reporter cell-level environment differences.
